items.headline: The Morning Build for November 1, 2026: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work, Intel Share Plunge, xAI Permit Suit
items.excerpt: OpenAI merges Chat and Work with shared token budgets in December; OpenAI will train on Daybreak Blue from Nov 29; judge lets NAACP v. xAI proceed; Intel warns on Q4.

items.headline: The Morning Build for October 31, 2026: OpenAI’s stalled raise, Claude agents in the lab, and moonshot infra
items.excerpt: OpenAI raised $11B of a $30B target; a Claude agent performed an autonomous mouse surgery; a backdoor hit Claude Code; Nvidia may cosign Nscale debt; Google’s TPU satellite is online.

items.headline: The Morning Build for October 30, 2026: Mistral's Le Chonk, Google BYOA for Android, AWS's $220B capex, and Dream's world models
items.excerpt: Mistral releases Large 4 weights; Google opens Android Studio to external agents; AWS plans $220B 2026 capex; Dream raises $17M for construction world models.

items.headline: The Morning Build for October 29, 2026: Gemini 4 Carbon, Microsoft’s OpenAI Billings, Nvidia Nemotron 3.5, Claude Code telemetry, and Anthropic’s hiring shift
items.excerpt: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon for cyberdefense; Microsoft reports $10B from OpenAI; Nvidia open-sources Nemotron 3.5; Claude Code telemetry exposes agent transcripts.

items.headline: The Morning Build for October 28, 2026: Google’s Genie 4 Launches, Anthropic Files to Go Public, and Delaware’s AI-Run Company Plan
items.excerpt: Genie 4 research preview from DeepMind, Anthropic's S-1 with $16.3B H1 revenue and Founder LLC control, OpenAI partner pipeline analysis, and Delaware’s AI-run company draft.

items.headline: The Morning Build for October 27, 2026: OpenAI's always-on 'dots', GPT-6.1 Terra price cut, and Anthropic's S-1
items.excerpt: OpenAI launches always-on assistant dots for Pro subscribers; GPT-6.1 Terra halves API prices; Anthropic files S-1 showing $11.6B Q2 revenue and $780B compute commitments.

items.headline: The Morning Build for October 26, 2026: Nvidia open-sources Flora, LLM prices fall, and agents compress
items.excerpt: Nvidia open-sources Flora for robot video labeling; OpenAI and Anthropic cut token prices; Anthropic publishes a single-agent migration kit; plus a roundup of SMS agents.
